title: DeepLook: Uncertainty-Guided Branching with Lookahead Confidence for Efficient Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.22602v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Test-time scaling improves large language model reasoning, but spends compute uniformly along a reasoning trace, even in stretches that are already stable. Motivated by the observation that reasoning failures show an early onset of uncertainty, we introduce DeepLook, a training-free decoding framework that monitors segment-level confidence, branches only at uncertainty bottlenecks, and ranks candidate continuations by Average Lookahead Confidence (ALC)---their mean confidence over fixed-horizon rollouts---before completing and voting over a pruned subset. On four competition mathematics benchmarks across four open models, DeepLook matches or exceeds the accuracy of DeepConf-low in 12 of 16 settings while generating 87.3% fewer tokens, showing that a model's own confidence is informative enough to decide where extra decoding compute is worth spending. translated_title: DeepLook：基于前瞻置信度的不确定性引导分支，实现高效推理
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但它会在整条推理路径上均匀消耗算力，即使某些片段已经处于稳定状态也是如此。基于“推理失败往往在早期就显现出不确定性”这一观察，我们提出了 DeepLook——一个无需训练的解码框架。该框架监控片段级别的置信度，仅在不确定性瓶颈处进行分支，并通过平均前瞻置信度——即在固定前瞻范围 rollout 上的平均置信度——对候选续写进行排序，随后在剪枝后的子集上完成推理并进行投票。在四个开放模型和四个竞赛数学基准上，DeepLook 在 16 个设置中的 12 个里达到或超过 DeepConf-low 的准确率，同时生成的 token 数量减少了 87.3%，这表明模型自身的置信度所蕴含的信息足以判断在何处值得投入额外的解码算力。在知识密集型的 GPQA-Diamond 基准上，准确率优势则消失了，尽管……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DeepLook 是一种无需训练的解码框架，通过仅在不确定性瓶颈处分支并利用平均前瞻置信度（ALC）对候选路径排序筛选，在四个竞赛数学基准上以减少 87.3% 的 token 生成量达到或超越 DeepConf-low 的准确率。
en_tdlr: DeepLook is a training-free decoding framework that branches only at uncertainty bottlenecks and ranks candidate continuations by Average Lookahead Confidence (ALC), matching or exceeding DeepConf-low accuracy on four competition math benchmarks while generating 87.3% fewer tokens.
